label: I can't get myself out of bed or off the couch
helper: Starting is the hardest part. We'll begin really small.

label: My days have lost their shape
helper: No job, sick leave, retired, between semesters — days can blur.

label: I've pulled away from people
helper: Reaching out can feel big. Small hellos count.

label: My sleep is all over the place
helper: A steady morning is a good anchor for the whole day.

label: My days are only work — everything else is on pause
helper: Let's make room for what matters outside work.

label: I'm running on empty
helper: Low energy is real, not a lack of willpower.

label: Hours disappear into games
helper: Games can stay. Let's plan them and add a few other things.

label: I scroll or binge-watch more than I want
helper: No guilt — just a few planned stopping points.

label: Starting things is hard, so I put them off
helper: Two-minute versions are made for this.

label: Worry makes me avoid things
helper: One small step toward something you've been avoiding.

label: I'm going through a loss or a big change
helper: Gentle days are fine. Small routines can hold you.

label: I'm feeling better and want to keep it that way
helper: Keep what helped, at a pace that works.
